title: Service Desk Administrator
description:
Service Desk Administrator

About Ricoh

A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies, and have been named one of Forbes World s Best Employers 2025.

At Ricoh, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued and supported. We create inclusive workplaces where you can grow, contribute, and make a positive impact while helping to build a more sustainable future.

Find your place. Transform your future

Our purpose is centred on understanding and improving how people work. By focusing on real working experiences, we support individuals to develop their skills, realise their potential and do work that feels meaningful.

People transform when they Love What They Do

This belief sits at the heart of The Ricoh Promise. It guides how we recruit, how we support our people, and how we work together every day, creating an environment where you can grow, feel valued and make a difference.

When you join us, you are encouraged to share your ideas, challenge the way things are done, and work with others to build something better. If you are looking for a place where your voice is heard, your development is supported, and your work feels meaningful, you will feel at home at Ricoh.

- Provide functional escalation to internal, customer and 3rd party supplier resolver groups so that service level agreements can be met on a monthly basis
- To work alongside the Data Analyst in helping manage and maintain customer data into the internal system ensuring it means all requirements specified by the business.
- To provide administrative support to the shared managed service desk

The Service Desk Administrator will ideally have
- Experience of working in an IT environment
- Experience of using a service management system such as ServiceNow
- Awareness of ITIL framework
- General knowledge of Third party support agreement(s)
- A basic understanding of Service level agreements or arrangement(s)
- Excellent Customer Service & Telephone handling skills
- Must be capable of working unsupervised to agreed timescales
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Excellent interpersonal skills
- Ability to organise and prioritise work in an effective manner
- Ability to work under pressure
- Ability to work well in a team

title: Commercial Administrator
description:
Commercial Administrator
£28,000 per annum
Redditch
Talent Guardian is recruiting on behalf of a growing consolidator and distributor of fine food, drink and fresh produce, supplying the independent retail and foodservice sectors.
Everything they supply is consolidated and distributed from a purpose-built Distribution Centre in Redditch, ensuring it meets their strict quality standards. Due to continued growth, they're looking for a Commercial Administrator to act as a key support function to the commercial department.
The role This is a varied, hands-on commercial support role with real exposure across the business you'll work alongside the Business Development team and provide executive support to the Managing Director and heads of department.
- Set up and maintain new and existing suppliers and products
- Set up and maintain customer accounts, including IT system setup
- Handle pricing and system administration, including producing customer pricelists in line with defined retail periods
- Produce weekly sales reports across all customers
- Support the processing of customer sales orders from various sources (EDI, email, telephone)

- Assist the Business Development team with customer-related requirements

What you'll need

- Some experience of customer/supplier liaison and negotiation, including margin and P&L comprehension, would be beneficial
- Strong communication skills, with experience dealing with internal stakeholders, customers and suppliers
- Confident IT skills, particularly Excel and Microsoft applications
- Highly numerate, with strong diligence and attention to detail
- Own transport and a full UK driving licence
- Based full time at the Worcestershire head office
- GCSE or equivalent education
- Punctual, self-motivated, and able to work both in a team and on your own initiative

Hours & benefits
- £28,080 per annum (full time, 40 hours per week)
- Monday to Friday, with flexibility aligned to business requirements
- Annual holiday allowance
- Employee benefits scheme and pension scheme
- Free on-site secure parking
- Training provided, including product knowledge and company policies and procedures

title: Administrator
description:
Job Title: Administrator

Location: Worcester, UK - Hybrid

Salary: 11,200 actual salary based on a full-time equivalent of 28,000 (0.4 FTE, 2 days per week)

Job Type: Permanent, Part-time remote home-working, within a commutable distance of the Worcester office. Home/office split to be agreed.

Are you an organised, proactive administrator looking for a rewarding role where you can make a real difference?

Music Therapy Works is looking for an Administrator to play a central role in supporting the operational efficiency of our charity. This varied role provides administrative, financial, HR and governance support, working closely with the CEO, Clinical Lead, music therapists, trustees, contractors and external stakeholders to ensure the organisation runs smoothly, securely and professionally.

Key Responsibilities:

Clients:
- Maintain secure, accurate and up-to-date client records from initial enquiry or referral onwards.
- Coordinate client documentation, including contracts, consent forms, risk assessments, letters of assurance, forecast hours and evaluation surveys.
- Support the CEO and Clinical Lead in coordinating music therapist caseloads.
- Manage routine correspondence with existing and prospective clients, ensuring confidentiality and data protection.

Our People:
- Coordinate recruitment and onboarding of employees, contractors and trustees.
- Maintain secure records for trustees, employees, contractors, volunteers and placement students.
- Administer routine HR processes, including annual leave, absence tracking and draft contracts.
- Coordinate DBS checks and provide professional administrative support to the wider team.

Finance & Governance:
- Support the Finance Officer with information for client invoicing and staff payroll.
- Maintain records for funders and donors and undertake routine financial administration, including paying in cheques.
- Take and distribute accurate minutes for Board and subcommittee meetings.
- Coordinate the filing, review and distribution of organisational policies and support effective governance administration.

General Administration:
- Maintain organised, accurate and secure physical and digital filing systems.
- Coordinate room bookings, online meetings, away days, training days and other events.
- Maintain the company asset register.
- Administer digital workspaces and tools, including Microsoft 365 and Apple Business.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and efficiency.
- Undertake other duties commensurate with the role as required.

What can we offer you in return?

You'll be joining Music Therapy Works at an exciting time, with the opportunity to play an important role in supporting the organisation's continued development and impact.

We offer a flexible hybrid working arrangement, with part-time home-working and time spent at our Worcester office as agreed.

You'll also benefit from:
- 33 days' holiday per year (FTE).
- NEST pension.
- Cyclescheme.
- Safeguarding training.
- Enhanced DBS check.
- A supportive and purpose-driven working environment.
- The opportunity to develop your skills and contribute to the work of a specialist organisation making a positive difference through music therapy.

About You:

If you join the team, we'll provide you with the support and training you need to succeed in the role and develop your skills.

To succeed in this role, you will bring the following skills, experience and behaviours:
- Proven experience in an administrative or office management role.
- Excellent IT skills, including Microsoft 365 applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint.
- Experience of accurately taking and producing minutes for professional meetings.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your communication appropriately when working with employees, trustees, contractors, customers, partner organisations, funders and donors.
- Experience of organising and maintaining confidential filing systems and sensitive records.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate bookings, meetings, events and competing priorities effectively.
- Experience of supporting basic HR processes, such as annual leave and absence tracking.
- Confidence in supporting financial administration, including payroll and invoicing processes.
- A strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection and the importance of securely managing sensitive information.
- A proactive, reliable and highly organised approach to work.
- The ability to work independently while also contributing positively as part of a wider team.
- Willingness to use AI tools and develop AI-related skills to improve efficiency and ways of working.
- Ability to work flexibly between home and the Worcester office.

Desirable experience includes:
- Experience of working or volunteering within a charity or third-sector organisation.
- Familiarity with a clinical, medical or therapeutic setting.
- Experience maintaining records for funders and donors.
- Basic knowledge of, or confidence in, preparing draft contracts using templates.
- Experience administering CRM systems.
- Knowledge and experience of using Apple Business.

Important dates for consideration:
- 20thSeptember: deadline for applications.
- 25thSeptember: invitations to first interview.
- 6th& 7th October: first interviews, online.
- 8thOctober: invitations to second interview.
- 13thOctober: second interviews, in person only at The Hive, Worcester, WR1 3 PD.

Employees are required to complete an Enhanced DBS check for the Child and Adult Workforce.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV.
